title: Codes of cultural practices for aromatic plants, Part 4: Mentha (Japanese mint) and Mentha citrata (Bergamint)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard ( Part 4 ) prescribes a code of practice for cultivation of the aromatic plants for production of oil of Japanese mint botanically known as Mentha arvensis var. piperascens Holmes and Bcrgamot-mint botanically known as Mentha ciirata Ehrh. Family Labiateae. These are natives of Mediterranean countries introduced into cultivation since last two decades. Of these Japanese mint is cultivated extensively in Rampur, Moradabad and Barabanki districts of U.P. and terai districts of Punjab. The cultivation of Bergamot-mint is limited and scattered in Budaon in U.P. 1.2 The requirements and methods of sampling and tests for oil of Mentha arvensis and Mentha citrata have been separately covered in and respectively.
